ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a line graph of changes in lake water salinity of Qinghai Lake over approximately the past 12,000 years. The horizontal axis represents time before present, with the unit being thousand years, ranging from about 0 to 12; the vertical axis represents salt content, with the unit being g/L. The line shows the highest peak of the whole figure near 8 thousand years before present, positioned slightly to the right of the 8-thousand-year mark, about 8.1 thousand years. Then reason: The prompt states that changes in lake water salt content can reflect lake water level. Generally, the lower the lake water level, the more obvious the concentration of lake water, and the higher the salt content; therefore the lowest water level should correspond to the time of the highest salt content in the figure. The highest salt content in the figure appears at about 8.1 thousand years before present, which converted into years is about 8100 years.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图为青海湖近1.2万年来含盐量随距今时间变化的折线图，横轴单位为千年，纵轴为含盐量。根据题干说明盐分可反映湖泊水位，采用水位低则盐分高的关系。然后在图中寻找盐分含量的最高点，最高峰位于8千年刻度稍右侧，约为8.1千年。最后把单位换算成“年”，得最低水位出现时间距今约8100年。

raw_record.original_question:
湖水中盐分含量的变化可以反映湖泊水位以及气候的变化，下图所示为青海湖近1.2万年以来盐分含量的变化。读图回答下列问题。

<image1>

青海湖近1.2万年来，最低水位出现的时间距今约多少年？
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: The figure is a line graph of changes in the salt content of Qinghai Lake water over the past nearly 12,000 years; the horizontal axis represents time before present, with the unit being thousand years, and the range about 0 to 12; the vertical axis represents salt content, with the unit being g/L. The line has the highest peak in the whole figure near 8 thousand years before present, located slightly to the right of the 8-thousand-year tick mark, about 8.1 thousand years.
Then reason: The question stem states that changes in the salt content of lake water can reflect the lake water level. Generally, the lower the lake water level, the more obvious the concentration of lake water, and the higher the salt content; therefore the lowest water level should correspond to the time of the highest salt content in the figure. The highest salt content in the figure appears at about 8.1 thousand years before present, which converted into years is about 8100 years.
